title: gymnogramma elliptica
intro: Gymnogramma elliptica, commonly known as the Gymnogramma fern, is a type of flowering plant in the family Compositae and is also classified as a type of fern. It is traditionally used in folk medicine in various parts of the world due to its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Gymnogramma elliptica include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents responsible for its health benefits are flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, although further research is needed to fully understand its properties and potential uses.
